## Summary
The book page offers a reserve button for an available copy and shows the pickup date after it.

## Key design decisions
The reserve button sits beside the availability line so a reader sees the copy status first.

## States covered
The page shows available, reserved and unavailable copies, and the failure of a reservation.

## Component references
Use the existing button and status chip of the reader app.

## Open design questions
No design question is open.
